\begin{highlights}
\item A general scheme separates language model, harness, instructions and model builder
\item Without instructions, three harnesses reach similar accuracy at different run times
\item Accuracy rises when an AutoML library builds and tunes the model
\item The same instruction file or larger model helps one harness and hurts another
\item No configuration reaches the strongest tuned method published with the benchmark
\end{highlights}
